title: Alphabet Pages Year 1 (Playing Preschool companion)

layout.visualHierarchy: letter-only — one giant uppercase bubble letter fills the entire page

skillTargeting.subject: English
skillTargeting.notes: Also targets fine motor (decorating, cutting, gluing) and art (process art on letter shapes). The letter is a canvas, not a tracing exercise.

difficulty.scaffolding: low — completely open-ended, child decides how to decorate

theming.visualStyle: bold outline bubble letters — thick black outlines, rounded, hand-drawn feel
appealDrivers: giant size fills page — satisfying to decorate
thick outlines easy for young hands
open canvas for any medium (paint, stickers, collage, crayons)

printFormat.margins: minimal — letter fills most of the page
printFormat.colorRequirement: B&W only (designed to be decorated, not pre-colored)

gaps.name: alphabet-art-page
gaps.description: One giant bubble letter per page (uppercase only for preschool, both cases for older). Thick outline, designed as a craft canvas — child decorates with paint, dot stickers, collage materials, etc. Then cuts out and collects into an alphabet portfolio. Different from tracing-guide (which is about motor memory and formation). This is about letter recognition through creative art.

coverPage.title: ALPHABET CRAFT BOOK
coverPage.style: Patterned border with colorful learning icons (blocks, beakers, flowers, lightbulbs, shapes) — childlike but polished. Center white panel with bold block title.
coverPage.notes: Cover page doubles as a portfolio title page. Child writes their name in the blank space.

notes: This is the printable companion to Playing Preschool Year 1 (dropped in the previous message). 26 uppercase bubble letters (A-Z) + intro page + cover page = 29 pages. Each letter is introduced during its unit in the main curriculum (e.g., Aa in Unit 1 Apples, Rr in Unit 2 Colors). The child decorates one letter per unit, building a keepsake alphabet book over the school year. Design is intentionally minimal — the letter IS the page, leaving maximum creative freedom.
